about.title: Union City Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: When someone dies because another person was careless, the people left behind in Union City are asked to do two hard things at once: grieve, and make decisions. A wrongful death claim is one of those decisions, and it does not have to be made alone. In 2025, public records show 5 traffic deaths in Union City, alongside 179 injury collisions on streets like Alvarado Niles Road, Mission Boulevard, Whipple Road and the I-880 corridor. Each of those numbers was a person with a household, a routine, and people who counted on them. California allows a surviving spouse or domestic partner and children to bring a civil claim first, with certain dependents and heirs eligible after that. The claim can seek funeral and burial costs, the financial support the person would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship and guidance. LawProactive is not a law firm. We connect Union City families, free of charge, with an independent attorney who handles these cases on contingency, so you can ask questions before committing to anything.

whyChoose.title: What Union City Families Should Know Before Filing

items.title: Who is allowed to bring the claim
items.desc: California limits standing: a surviving spouse or domestic partner and children come first, and certain dependents or heirs may qualify after them. An attorney can confirm where your family fits before anything is filed.

items.title: The clock is already running
items.desc: Most wrongful death claims in California must be filed within two years of the date of death, and the window is shorter when a government entity is involved. Getting an early review protects that deadline.

items.title: A civil claim is separate from any criminal case
items.desc: Even if police or prosecutors are involved, your family's civil claim stands on its own and can address funeral costs, lost financial support, and the loss of love, companionship and guidance.

items.question: My family member was killed in a crash on I-880 in Union City. Do we have to wait for the police investigation to finish?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil matter and can move forward independently of any criminal investigation or charges. In fact, starting early helps an attorney gather evidence like scene photos, vehicle data and witness accounts while they are still available. The two-year deadline runs from the date of death regardless of how long the criminal process takes.

items.question: Who in our family is actually allowed to file?
items.answer: California gives first priority to the surviving spouse or registered domestic partner and the children of the person who died. If there is no one in that group, certain financial dependents and heirs may be eligible. Because families are rarely simple, an attorney can sort out who should be named so the claim is not delayed or dismissed on a technicality.

items.question: What if a city vehicle, a road defect, or another public agency played a role?
items.answer: Claims against a government entity in California follow a much shorter timeline than the standard two years, and they usually require a formal notice step before a lawsuit can be filed. Missing that early deadline can end the claim entirely. If you suspect a public agency was involved anywhere in Alameda County, it is worth speaking with an attorney as soon as you are able.
